wasm_notes: No ROM file: the Midiverb/Midifex/Midiverb II programs ship in the repo as decompiled C (decompiled-*.h, from thement/midiverb_emulator, GPL-3.0). Redistribution follows upstream's licensing; worth a legal glance since it derives from the unit's ROM.
